page.layout: One printed page, single column of dictionary entries; running head at top centre "G R." with page number 313 at top right; catchword "Grumus" at bottom right; signature "V 5" at foot centre; "Virg." at bottom left is a catchword-like mark of the previous entry, treated as catchword line.

main_text.p: teris stat gratia facti, Virg. Quod beneficium haud sterili te obsevisse, in segete cognosces, Acci.
Gravare] Aggravare, Quint. Deprimere, Plaut. Prægravare, Plin. Coonerare, Tac.
Gravari] Urgeri onere. Urget onus, Cic. Gravat me iste labor. Urgetur corpus mole, Virg. Est mihi oneri, Liv.
Gravedo] Destillatio, Cæs. Rheumatisma, Cæl. Rhod. Destillans humor, Cels.
Gravida mulier] Prægnans fœmina, Cic. Repleta, Justin. Gravida puero mulier, Plaut. Fœta, Col. Virg. Gravis utero, Plin.
Gravidant se animalia] Faciunt gravida, Plaut. Implent fœmellam, Col. Ter. Implevit uterum generoso sanguine, Ovid.
Graviditas] Alvus gravida, Fest. Prægnatio animalium, arborum, Varr.
Grave quid] Onus Æthnâ gravius sustinere. Oneris magni. Gravior quàm ut ferri possit.
Gravis] Ponderosus. Onerosus, gravida manus, Plaut. Multas manus poscit. Ingestabilis. Prægravis, Plin. Pondus habens, Ovid. Injustus fascis, Virg. Contrarium æs, Fest.

Gravis vir] Auctoritate gravis. Magnæ auctoritatis. Magna auctoritate. Habet auctoritatem. Valet auctoritate. Præditus auctoritate. Vir in quo summa est auctoritas & amplitudo. Serius & gravis vir. Dignitatis retinens. Locuples auctor, Cic. Amplissimus auctor, Tac. Plin.
Graviter] Graviter concidit, Virg. Prægraviter, Cic. Gravatim cadere, Lucr.

Gregatim] Frequenter, frequentissimi venerunt, Cic. Cæs. Catervatim volant sturni, Plin. Acervatim, Id. Uno grege, Curt. Globatim dispersi prædones, Amm. Conglobatim, Liv. Congestim, fartim, coacervatim, Apul. Congestè, Iul. Cap. Numerosissimè, Apul. Glomeratim eunt, Macrob.
Gremium vestis] Lacinia, Plaut. Ala vestis, Scal. Alaria, pl.
